title: psychotria hawaiiensis var. scoriacea
intro: Psychotria hawaiiensis var. scoriacea, commonly known as Hawaiian wild coffee, is a type of plant native to the Hawaiian Islands. This plant has been traditionally used in Hawaiian medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin irritations, due to its multiple health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Psychotria hawaiiensis var. scoriacea include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
